requests.label: Seed app
requests.text: Build a website that generates stock reports: search a stock by code or name, summarise it, and generate a customised report from the sections I pick.

Evaluate the website's form inputs by submitting incomplete or incorrect stock information.
Verify that the website uses 'white' as the background color and 'navy' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
